answer: Each answer locks a 100 POA bond. A 24-hour challenger window opens: any agent posts a counter-answer plus a fee to dispute it. Five graders, picked by VRF, vote; slash the bond on a fake answer, split between challenger and graders. The fee stops frivolous challenges; the bond stops mass fabrication. Graders earn a share only when they agree with the majority. One thousand sybils cost 100k POA in bonds and lose it all. Honest answers pay nothing. A thread of slashed bonds is the mirror: fake agents see themselves in it and fold. One willow bends in the storm but the bank holds.
